hints.text: Both terms count the same thing, $x$. Think of $4$ apples plus $3$ apples.
Because both terms have $x$, add only the numbers in front, $4 + 3$, and keep the $x$.

explanation: $4x$ and $3x$ are like terms because they have the same variable, $x$.
Like terms are combined by adding their coefficients: $4 + 3 = 7$.
The variable stays the same, so $4x + 3x$ simplifies to $7x$.
